notes.title: Be aware of scammers and impersonators.
notes.notes:
We found out about a few programs who listed "Dawn Studios" as developer & publisher, who are not associated with us.

We only use socials listed below:
[url=https://x.com/dawnstudiosint]X (Twitter)[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/dawnstudiosint/]Instagram[/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@dawnstudiosint]TikTok[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@DawnStudiosInt]YouTube[/url]

Any upcoming games will be published on those socials but for now the only game that is associated with us is "WIDEN".

We also don't ask for user credentials or contact you on other social media accounts.

Stay safe!

Dawn Studios development team.
